column1: # Characters where pypinyin's usual reading is NOT the one that goes with the meaning taught on this site.
# The pinyin check normally compares the shown pinyin with pypinyin. For these characters it also accepts the reading below.

column3: long (cháng); pypinyin's default zhǎng means "to grow, chief"
the verb "to teach" (jiāo); pypinyin's default jiào is for 教室, 教育
the particle after an adverb (高兴地说); dì is only inside words like 地铁
the particle after a verb (说得好); dé is only inside words like 获得
the experience particle (去过); guò is the verb and is inside 过来, 过去, 过年
dirty (zāng); pypinyin default zàng is for organs (内脏, 心脏)
kind, type (zhǒng) in 这种, 各种, 一种; pypinyin guesses zhòng (to plant) before a noun like 花
must (děi) before a verb: 我得走了; pypinyin guesses de or dé
to get (dé) in 得了 + a number: 他考试得了一百分
photo (zhàopiàn) in 照片; pypinyin reads it piān, which is only the spoken form with 儿 (照片儿)
